note: Registry and catalogue sources were out of scope per instructions, so no MCA/GSTIN lookup was performed and no CIN/PAN is asserted (pan_claimed was empty). Declared HS 760720 (aluminium foil, backed, thickness <=0.2mm) could not be checked against any actual shipment line, so no HS correction is proposed and no rejection ground exists. Critically: this is NOT a finding of absence — it is a failure of access. Every trade-data source for this name was paywalled or blocked, so neither export nor domestic supply can be confirmed or denied. Per Rule 5 the correct label is 'unknown', not 'declared_only' (the company made no claim we could read) and not 'none_found' (we did not search a readable dataset). Follow-up needed with a paid Volza/Eximpedia seat or a direct IEC lookup before any verdict on actual shipments.
